parameters.name: Sorts
parameters.description:
Allow for sorting on multiple properties using "by" and "order".
"Sorts[x].by" specifies the property on which to sort e.g. name.
"Sorts[x].order" specifies the order in which to sort e.g. asc or desc.
The index "x" specifies the order the sorts are applied. The index must start at 0 and each index must be consecutive e.g. 0, 1, 2.
For example Sorts[0].by, Sorts[0].order, Sorts[1].by, Sorts[1].order. 
Also supports repeated objects notation (multiple sorts): Sorts={"By":"name","Order":"Asc"}&Sorts={"By":"created","Order":"Desc"}

post.summary: Create, delete applications within application groups in a specified policy for a Windows policy.
post.description:
To update an existing application in the policy, first use the DELETE endpoint to remove the current application, then use the CREATE endpoint to add the updated version.

Supported application types for creation: bat, com, cpl, exe, msc, msi, ps1, reg, rpsc, rpss, unex, wsh.
Unsupported application types for creation: ocx, svc, appx, unin (will not be supported in the future), dll, cont.
            
Unsupported Matchers are: ActiveXCodebase, MaxVersion, MinVersion, ServiceConfigure, ServiceDisplayName, ServiceName, WindowsStorePackageName, WindowsStorePublisher

To include a backslash in a string field, type \ twice (\\\\).
